The fix: default stage name should be "train" for both default and dl types? The issue comment says: "with --dl, I don't think `dl` as a default stage name makes sense. Maybe we should go with `train` then?" And title: "exp init: change stage name to `train`". This suggests the stage name should be "train" by default (for both types? or only dl?).

Looking at the upstream DVC commit history — I shouldn't rely on memory, but the issue title says "exp init: change stage name to `train`", suggesting the default stage name should become "train". entries.author: teacher
entries.content: **Root cause and fix:** `dvc exp init` derived the default stage name from the `--type` value, so `--type dl` produced a stage named `dl` (and the default type produced `default`). In `dvc/repo/experiments/init.py`, `init()` did `name = name or type`, and `dvc/command/experiments.py`'s `CmdExperimentsInit.run()` mirrored this with `name = self.args.name or self.args.type` for the "Created ... stage" message. Both fallbacks were changed to `"train"`, so `exp init` (with either `--type default` or `--type dl`) now creates a `train` stage unless an explicit `--name`/`-n` is given. The `--type` option itself still controls dvclive/checkpoint behavior; only the naming default changed. Verified via CLI runs that default, `--type dl`, and custom-name cases all produce correctly named stages with unchanged content.
